mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ctg_group ( owner_user_id, category_id, intro, group_name, join_message, created_at ) VALUES ( #{ownerUserId}, #{categoryId}, #{intro}, #{groupName}, #{joinMessage}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(user_id) FROM group_users WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT gu.user_id, cu.nickname , gu.role, gu.joined_at FROM group_users gu LEFT JOIN ctg_users cu ON gu.user_id = cu.user_id WHERE gu.group_id = #{groupId} AND gu.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY gu.joined_at ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT schedule_id, group_id, user_id, title, content, start_time, end_time FROM schedule WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND start_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY start_time ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT board_id, group_id, user_id, title, content, created_at, view_count FROM group_board WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT cg.group_id, cg.owner_user_id, cg.category_id, cg.group_name, cg.intro, cg.join_message, cg.created_at, cg.profile_image, cc.category_name, CONCAT(cgl.city, ' ', cgl.district, ' ', cgl.neighborhood) AS region FROM group_users gu LEFT JOIN ctg_group cg ON gu.group_id = cg.group_id LEFT JOIN ctg_categories cc ON cg.category_id = cc.category_id LEFT JOIN ctg_group_location cgl ON cg.group_id = cgl.group_id WHERE gu.user_id = #{userId} AND gu.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT gj.user_id, gj.group_id, g.group_name, g.category_id, gj.join_status AS status, gj.created_at AS joinedAt, gj.processed_at AS leftAt FROM ctg_group_join gj JOIN ctg_group g ON gj.group_id = g.group_id WHERE gj.user_id = #{userId} AND gj.join_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY gj.created_at DESC

SELECT g.group_id, g.owner_user_id, g.category_id, g.group_name, g.intro, g.join_message, g.created_at, c.category_name, CONCAT(gl.city, ' ', gl.district, ' ', gl.neighborhood) AS region FROM ctg_group g LEFT JOIN ctg_categories c ON g.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN ctg_group_location gl ON g.group_id = gl.group_id WHERE g.group_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY g.created_at DESC

SELECT g.group_id, g.group_name, g.intro, g.created_at, g.category_id, g.group_status, c.category_name, CONCAT( IFNULL(l.city, ''), ' ', IFNULL(l.district, ''), ' ', IFNULL(l.neighborhood, '') ) AS region, COUNT(gu.user_id) AS memberCount FROM ctg_group g LEFT JOIN group_users gu ON g.group_id = gu.group_id LEFT JOIN ctg_categories c ON g.category_id = c.category_id LEFT JOIN ctg_group_location l ON g.group_id = l.group_id
AND (g.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR g.intro LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND ( l.city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%') OR l.district LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%') OR l.neighborhood LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%') )
AND g.category_id = #{category}
GROUP BY g.group_id, g.group_name, g.intro, g.created_at, g.category_id, g.group_status, c.category_name, l.city, l.district, l.neighborhood
ORDER BY memberCount DESC
ORDER BY g.created_at DESC
ORDER BY g.group_id DESC
